fields.Brand Customer Promise: A refreshed, dependable stay for business and leisure travelers—because behind every great day is a great night—with complimentary hot breakfast, free Wi-Fi, and practical amenities at more than 1,800 properties.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Trusted reliability for 30+ years; modernized rooms and public spaces; largest 100% smoke-free hotel brand in North America; hot, hearty breakfast and fitness or pool at most locations.

Owners: Upper-midscale segment leadership with Move to Modern standards, strong pipeline (~300 hotels cited in 2018 materials), and $2.5B system investment in guest experience (historical transformation program).

Choice: Choice Privileges, distribution, and development support through choicehotelsdevelopment.com/comfort.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Rested. Set. Go. — guest-ready comfort for the day ahead.

Move to Modern — refreshed lobbies, updated guest rooms, premium bedding, smoke-free properties.

Everyday travel reliability — business and leisure essentials done consistently.

Scale and trust — one of North America’s largest midscale footprints.
fields.Brand History: The Comfort brand family has served travelers and owners for more than 30 years. Choice’s transformation journey began in 2012 with Move to Modern upgrades across U.S. properties (press materials through 2018–2020 signage rollout).
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Practical business and leisure travelers who want predictable comfort, a strong breakfast offering, and updated rooms without luxury pricing—valuing smoke-free environments and amenities that help them stay productive or unwind efficiently.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Rested. Set. Go. brand platform tied to renovated guest experience.

Largest 100% smoke-free midscale brand in North America (2018 announcement).

Complimentary hot breakfast and standard Wi-Fi/business/fitness amenities.

Accelerating development pipeline in primary U.S. markets.
